answer.summary: Carr described Amazon’s repeatable PR/FAQ process: start with the customer’s needs, write a customer-focused press release for the proposed product or feature, and use that process to decide what to build before turning to how to ship it.

sections.heading: The PR/FAQ process
sections.content: Carr said Amazon turned the idea of working backwards into a scalable, repeatable process called PR/FAQ. When devising a new product or feature, begin with the customer’s needs and write a press release describing the offering in terms that speak to the customer. The description should make the value feel compelling—something that makes a customer think, “I will really need this.” The process is for deciding what to build; after that decision, the team can focus on shipping it efficiently and effectively.
